## Change

Describe the outcome and the problem it solves.

## Risk and scope

- [ ] Tenant/data isolation impact considered
- [ ] Security/privacy impact considered
- [ ] Availability/concurrency impact considered
- [ ] Backward compatibility or migration impact considered
- [ ] Compliance/evidence impact considered

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Dependency audit has no unresolved high/critical finding
- [ ] Tests cover changed invariants
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated

## Evidence

Link issues/decisions and note any control, risk, exception, or operational evidence affected by this change.
